test_title: PYST 57: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and L, are sitting in a row facing North. Only three people sit between D and G. C sits to the immediate left of G. No one sits to the right of L. Only two people sit between L and C. B sits to the immediate right of E. How many people sit between F and B?
solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and L, are sitting in a row facing North.

1) Only three people sit between D and G.

2) C sits to the immediate left of G.

3) No one sits to the right of L.

4) Only two people sit between L and C.

5) B sits to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/827922226d2f9e39ffbf9abdf38d81d2c99cd07396aab990e383dac060232e4a.png] 

So, There are **Two** people sit between F and B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
